column1: The Origins of Life|1999|0|0||8.5,8.5,8,8.5,8,9,8,9.5,8,8|John Maynard Smith and Eörs Szathmáry|General-reader explanation of major transitions in information storage, reproduction and cooperation, distinct from the authors' more technical 1995 work. https://academic.oup.com/book/51176 confirms both authors, 1999 and intended audience. Mechanisms and hypotheses remain distinguished from a solved account of life's first origin. D=8 low-confidence contents/description estimate: transitions from replication through cells and language add different coordination constraints. Not a technical curriculum; science rather than ecology is central, so no thematic deductions. Evolutionary processes are not a bounded human historical period, H13=0.

Charles Darwin: Voyaging|1995|0|0|1856|9,7.5,6.5,7,7.5,9,7.5,9.5,8.5,8.5|Janet Browne|Scientific biography of Darwin's education, expedition, evidence collection and early theory development. https://books.google.com/books/about/Voyaging.html?id=w266zwEACAAJ confirms 1995; Medical History review https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/aop-cambridge-core/content/view/5DA773FC290E7B50F69584CC41FD6635/S0025727300057392a.pdf confirms this volume ends in May 1856, not 1882 or the sequel's period. Scientific-biography V3 exception applies. D=7.5 low confidence from review/description: research habits and scientific networks add learning, family detail is lower-yield. No T11 merely because Darwin was British: central purpose is scientific life, not national history; no T12. Endpoint 1856.

Chance and Necessity|1970|0|10||7.5,7.5,7,7.5,8,9,7.5,9.5,8,8|Jacques Monod|Philosophical synthesis based on molecular biology and evolution; not a formal biology curriculum. https://obnb.uk/p7010992-chance-and-necessity-an-essay-on-the-national-philosophy-of-modern-biology verifies French original 1970 and English availability; https://search.worldcat.org/title/209901 provides the stated argument. Distinguish empirical claims about mutation/selection from broader metaphysical and ethical conclusions; biological findings alone do not establish every philosophical conclusion. D=8 low-confidence description estimate: molecular distinctions and their implications add learning, polemical extrapolation weakens E rather than automatically D. T12 philosophy, T11=0; timeless argument H13=0. No V5 merely for criticism of religion.

The Emergence of Life on Earth|2000|0|0||8.5,8,7,8,8,8.5,8,8.5,7.5,8|Iris Fry|Historical and scientific comparison of origin-of-life research, including RNA-first and metabolism-centered accounts. https://www.rutgersuniversitypress.org/emergence-of-life-on-earth/9780813527406 supplies contents and 2000 date; a related Hebrew book from 1997 is mentioned but identity as a direct translation is not established, so 2000 is the earliest verified production date for this work, moderate confidence. D=8 low confidence from contents and attributed specialist review excerpts: rival hypotheses and experimental histories add distinct constraints. Technical concepts support explanation rather than specialist training; no thematic penalties. Broad history of an ongoing scientific question H13=0. Later discoveries do not erase historical value; not treated as current comprehensive research.

You Are Here|2009|0|0||7.5,7.5,5.5,6.5,7,8,5.5,6.5,8.5,8|Christopher Potter|Popular synthesis from cosmological scale to biological complexity. https://books.google.com/books?id=lBEkFdYMsmIC and https://books.google.com/books/about/You_are_Here.html?id=hMF5cjsR9UwC verify author and 2009 English editions. General exposition, not a technical course. D=7 low-confidence contents/description estimate: scale comparisons add organization, much elementary physics is familiar to the intended reader; familiarity lowers F/U, not assumed objective padding. No thematic penalties or bounded historical period. Author is a literary publisher rather than a research physicist, reflected in A; no specific serious factual failure established.

Evolution Now|1982|0|0||8,7,6.5,7.5,7,8,7,9,6.5,7|John Maynard Smith, editor|Collection of scientific debates with editorial explanations for nonspecialists. https://wellcomecollection.org/works/df4kmzcd confirms 1982; book introduction and sampled passages indexed at https://www.scribd.com/document/680881248/John-Maynard-Smith-Eds-Evolution-Now-a-Century-After-Darwin-Macmillan-Education-UK-1982 explain the selection of controversies and explicitly support grasping the arguments without mastering every technical term. Retain with moderate eligibility confidence: main value is competing causal explanations, not procedures or a proficiency curriculum; some original papers are technical. D=7 moderate confidence from introduction and sampled genome/behavior passages: different debates add mechanisms, anthology jargon lowers reading yield. Historical state of research, not asserted current consensus. T11/T12/H13=0.

The Theory of Evolution|1958|0|0||8.5,7.5,7,8,8,8.5,7.5,9.5,8,8|John Maynard Smith|General scientific explanation of evolutionary evidence and mechanisms, not the author's mathematical modeling textbooks. https://www.si.edu/object/theory-evolution-john-maynard-smith%3Asiris_sil_463891 describes the purpose; https://assets.cambridge.org/97805214/51284/toc/9780521451284_toc.pdf lists experiments, heredity and speciation. Original 1958 confirmed by https://www.balzan.org/en/prizewinners/john-maynard-smith/bio-bibliography ; 1993 Canto revision does not reset age. D=8 low-confidence contents/description estimate: varied experiments and selection levels add substantive learning. No thematic penalties; evolutionary mechanisms H13=0. Historical editions are not comprehensive current genetics.

The Path to the Double Helix|1974|0|0|1953|9,8.5,8,8.5,8,9,8.5,9,7.5,8.5|Robert C. Olby|History of discovery connecting chemistry, physics, biological evidence, instruments and scientific networks. https://search.worldcat.org/title/940646 describes five converging research strands; https://wellcomecollection.org/works/bmuvu3wg verifies 1974 and references 445–496 of 510 numbered pages. Technical details explain discoveries rather than teach a laboratory curriculum. D=8 low-confidence contents/description estimate: competing approaches and evidence add causal depth, detailed research chronology may be less efficient. No disease deduction for molecular biology; no thematic penalties. Central discovery endpoint 1953.

How to Make a Human Being|2014|0|10||6.5,7,6,5.5,6.5,8,6,6.5,7.5,7|Christopher Potter|Philosophical investigation of consciousness, reductionism and human experience; title is not a procedural biological manual. https://philpapers.org/rec/POTHTM and https://obnb.uk/p16595951-how-to-make-a-human-being-a-body-of-evidence establish original 2014 rather than the 2015 paperback. An inability of one description to capture lived experience does not itself refute physical explanation, limiting E/M. D=6.5 low-confidence description estimate: contrasts across explanatory scales add distinctions, broad questions can outrun supporting argument. T12 philosophy, T11/H13=0. Asking about religion does not establish doctrinal advocacy; no specific serious veto established.

Mendel's Demon|2000|0|0||8.5,8,7.5,8.5,8.5,8.5,8,9,8,8|Mark Ridley|Sustained explanation of mutation, replication error and the evolution of complex genetic systems; also published as The Cooperative Gene. https://www.nature.com/articles/35086627 confirms title equivalence, 2000 original and exposition through thought experiments rather than specialist mathematics. Not Matt Ridley's work. D=8.5 moderate confidence from Andrew Berry's specialist review and contents: mutation loads, genetic conflict and reproductive mechanisms add distinct constraints; whole text not inspected. Hypotheses about sex and complexity are not treated as universally settled. No ecology/disease deduction, T11/T12/H13=0. References 304–315 in the US edition are documented, not inferred.

Darwinian Populations and Natural Selection|2009|0|10||8.5,8,8,8.5,8.5,9,8,9,7,8.5|Peter Godfrey-Smith|Conceptual analysis of reproduction, individuality, selection levels and limits of extending Darwinian reasoning to culture. https://academic.oup.com/book/4808 gives 2009 and contents; Massimo Pigliucci's review https://ndpr.nd.edu/reviews/darwinian-populations-and-natural-selection/ supports mechanism-focused philosophical argument. Retain with moderate eligibility confidence: model appendix supports conceptual explanation, not primary formal-proficiency training. D=8.5 moderate confidence from detailed review and contents: distinctions among population types and transitions add learning; specialist disputes can reduce accessibility. T12 philosophy of biology, T11=0; no bounded historical period. Review establishes serious attention, not unanimity.
